surface_score_policies.claim_boundary: Task-scoped benchmark attainment from IFEval and the compositional instruction fixture. A value at the suite ceiling means every scored check passed; it does not mean the model is perfect or establish a global intelligence rank.

Task-scoped coding evidence from the versioned headline benchmark mix. A separately labeled repository-edit diagnostic may support only its pinned miniature tasks; neither implies general software-engineering capability.
Task-scoped reasoning evidence from the versioned benchmark mix. It is not an expert-reasoning, global intelligence, or leaderboard claim.

coverage_expansion_priorities.why: Repeat the recent Qwen3.5 9B setup under the exact protocol before treating its high observed attainment as stable.
coverage_expansion_priorities.what_it_would_change: Adds exact repeatability evidence for a recent, high-attainment local model without allowing one run to define the capability frontier.

coverage_expansion_priorities.why: Repeat the reviewed Gemma 4 E4B candidate-runtime setup before using it as stable cross-family capability evidence.
coverage_expansion_priorities.what_it_would_change: Tests whether the first Gemma 4 score, task time, and memory observation reproduce on the same Mac and exact runtime protocol.

coverage_expansion_priorities.why: Repeat the official-publisher Ministral 3 setup to establish a compact current-model anchor outside the Qwen family.
coverage_expansion_priorities.what_it_would_change: Adds exact repeatability for a current 3B model and keeps the calibration cohort from becoming a single-vendor sample.

coverage_expansion_priorities.why: Repeat Qwen3 8B as a recent-generation bridge while the campaign shifts its leading edge to Qwen3.5, Gemma 4, Ministral 3, and gated Qwen3.6.
coverage_expansion_priorities.what_it_would_change: Adds a repeatable recent-generation comparison without letting older Qwen2.5 evidence lead new calibration work.

coverage_expansion_priorities.why: A reviewed sub-1B run fills the under-3B calibration band and tests whether Capability protocol v3.1 retains useful lower-tail discrimination.
coverage_expansion_priorities.what_it_would_change: Add the missing under-3B distribution band without requiring new hardware, while exposing the speed and task-time tradeoff of a very small local model.

coverage_expansion_priorities.why: Verify the official Gemma 4 12B artifact, b9994 runtime path, and conservative 16 GB fit before adding a stronger upper-band current-model observation.
coverage_expansion_priorities.what_it_would_change: Adds a second Gemma 4 size and a harder current-model headroom probe after every artifact, runtime, fit, and protocol gate passes.

coverage_expansion_priorities.why: Verify the official Ministral 3 8B GGUF and local protocol before using it as a new same-family size comparison.
coverage_expansion_priorities.what_it_would_change: Adds a current 8B setup and separates model-size effects from vendor-family effects on the same hardware.

coverage_expansion_priorities.why: Verify a pinned Qwen3.5 4B GGUF and the direct-answer protocol before adding a smaller current-generation Qwen anchor.
coverage_expansion_priorities.what_it_would_change: Adds current-generation size diversity and tests whether Qwen3.5's observed headroom persists below 9B.

coverage_expansion_priorities.why: Qwen3.6 is a high-credibility freshness target, but its community GGUF, 24 GB fit, prompt protocol, and llama.cpp behavior must be proven before benchmarking.
coverage_expansion_priorities.what_it_would_change: Adds the newest Qwen generation only after exact artifact, memory, runtime, and protocol checks succeed on suitable community hardware.
coverage_expansion_priorities.headroom_challenge_rationale: Curated current 27B local setup intended to stress every weighted surface after artifact, fit, runtime, and protocol qualification; selection does not claim frontier capability.

coverage_expansion_priorities.why: Establish a current-model coding anchor with executable HumanEval+ and MBPP+ evidence plus a zero-weight repository-edit diagnostic instead of relying on the historical Qwen2.5-Coder control.
coverage_expansion_priorities.what_it_would_change: Gives coding recommendations a current Qwen3.5 capability, speed, task-time, and memory observation while collecting repository-edit discrimination evidence without changing the coding score.

coverage_expansion_priorities.why: Establish a current-model reasoning anchor with exact-answer and sampled MMLU-Pro evidence plus a zero-weight expert diagnostic instead of relying on the historical Qwen2.5 control; the legacy direct-no-think constraint fixture is quarantined.
coverage_expansion_priorities.what_it_would_change: Gives reasoning recommendations a current Qwen3.5 capability, speed, task-time, and memory observation while collecting expert discrimination evidence without changing the reasoning score. The quarantined constraint fixture remains forensic-only.

coverage_expansion_priorities.why: Challenge the coding suite with the curated current 27B setup only after its 24 GB artifact, runtime, fit, and coding protocol path are qualified.
coverage_expansion_priorities.what_it_would_change: Tests coding-suite headroom against the same curated stress setup without treating model size or selection as a frontier-capability claim.
coverage_expansion_priorities.headroom_challenge_rationale: Curated current 27B local setup intended to stress the weighted coding surface after artifact, fit, runtime, and task-protocol qualification; selection does not claim frontier capability.

coverage_expansion_priorities.why: Challenge the reasoning suite with the curated current 27B setup only after its 24 GB artifact, runtime, fit, and direct-answer task protocol are qualified; the legacy direct-no-think constraint fixture is quarantined.
coverage_expansion_priorities.what_it_would_change: Tests weighted reasoning-suite and expert-reference evidence against the same curated setup without treating model size or selection as a frontier-capability claim. The quarantined constraint fixture remains forensic-only.
coverage_expansion_priorities.headroom_challenge_rationale: Curated current 27B local setup intended to stress the weighted reasoning surface after artifact, fit, runtime, and task-protocol qualification; selection does not claim frontier capability.

coverage_expansion_priorities.why: Retain Qwen2.5 only as an explicitly historical quant-control lane when user demand calls for it.
coverage_expansion_priorities.what_it_would_change: Preserves longitudinal and same-family quant context without letting an older model lead the new calibration campaign.

coverage_expansion_priorities.why: Coding recommendations need executable reference evidence before they can distinguish fast setup fit from useful coding behavior.
coverage_expansion_priorities.what_it_would_change: Promote coding answers from thin local/static evidence toward sampled reference evidence while keeping repo-edit and gold claims out of scope.

coverage_expansion_priorities.why: Reasoning answers should show when the evidence is only a thin exact-answer sample versus sampled MMLU-Pro reference evidence.
coverage_expansion_priorities.what_it_would_change: Give Recommend a direct next benchmark when reasoning evidence is missing, thin, or unstable.

coverage_expansion_priorities.why: Windows/NVIDIA is the core second tier, but it cannot influence recommendations until one full loop is proven on hardware.
coverage_expansion_priorities.what_it_would_change: Move Windows/NVIDIA from preflight-only preview toward a bounded technical beta for one known-good GGUF path.

benchmark_maturity_levels.gate_summary: Roadmap metadata only. The benchmark is not runnable until a fixture or dataset policy, harness, scoring policy, and claim boundary exist.
Runnable only for small pinned local fixtures with deterministic scoring and explicit thin-sample caveats.
Candidate for stronger local evidence after broader samples, repeatability, and observed duration or failure-rate metadata are reviewed.
Recognized or justified reference benchmark candidate that still needs a complete reproducible harness, scoring, dataset, or sandbox review.
Runnable intentionally selected reference evidence with pinned dataset or fixture revision, preserved raw/scoring artifacts, and explicit claim boundaries.
Potential high-legitimacy evidence that requires legal/access controls, stronger sandbox/runtime controls, and maintainer review before runnable product claims.
Runnable gold evidence only after reference gates, dataset/legal/access gates, sandbox controls, and maintainer-review gates are all satisfied.

benchmark_status_matrix.sample_policy: Pinned IFEval revision; canary and standard tiers greedily maximize distinct instruction-type coverage with deterministic hash tie-breaking instead of taking a positional prefix. Not a leaderboard protocol.
benchmark_status_matrix.claim_boundary: Instruction-following decision evidence only; not broad assistant quality or leaderboard evidence.
promotion_blockers: Pin exact sample/revision policy before promoting to reference evidence.
Replace estimated duration and token-volume metadata with observed bands.

benchmark_status_matrix.sample_policy: Five pinned synthetic transcript-retention cases retained as diagnostic smoke evidence after 35 of 37 scored public results reached the suite ceiling in the latest-300-result audit on 2026-07-14.
benchmark_status_matrix.claim_boundary: Saturated diagnostic assistant microcheck. Passing all cases proves only that the setup cleared this fixture; it contributes no headline score weight and cannot distinguish stronger models.
promotion_blockers: Do not restore headline weight without a new cross-model discrimination audit.
Repeated-run variance and observed duration metadata are not yet required.

benchmark_status_matrix.sample_policy: Twenty-four pinned synthetic compositional tasks scored by strict JSON equality; canary runs the first four.
benchmark_status_matrix.claim_boundary: Provisional local instruction-following evidence only. It is not psychometrically calibrated, preference quality, factual knowledge, global intelligence, or leaderboard evidence.
promotion_blockers: Run the pinned fixture across diverse current and older models and publish the score distribution.
Replace or expand items if the suite ceiling rate exceeds the documented threshold.
Keep IFEval as the established companion component until broader assistant-quality evidence is implemented.

benchmark_status_matrix.sample_policy: Three pinned static repair prompts with deterministic constraint scoring and no generated-code execution.
benchmark_status_matrix.claim_boundary: Thin local coding sample; not HumanEval+, LiveCodeBench, SWE-bench, or executable code-correctness evidence.
promotion_blockers: Executable coding evidence needs sandboxed unit-test execution.
Broader coding samples and repeated-run reporting are required before stronger local evidence.

benchmark_status_matrix.sample_policy: Three pinned synthetic exact-answer cases for quick local reasoning setup guidance.
benchmark_status_matrix.claim_boundary: Thin local reasoning sample; not GPQA, MMLU-Pro, expert reasoning, reference, or gold evidence.
promotion_blockers: Larger exact-answer sample and leakage-reviewed source policy are needed before stronger local evidence.
Reference reasoning requires recognized benchmark controls.

benchmark_status_matrix.sample_policy: Forty-eight pinned synthetic exact-answer cases interleaved across six task categories and eight rounds spanning four structural tiers; canary spans all six categories and standard runs four cases per category.
benchmark_status_matrix.claim_boundary: Legacy direct-no-think v1 synthetic reasoning fixture retained for forensic and unit-test artifacts only; excluded from runnable, readiness, recommendation, and release evidence. It is not a replacement score, global intelligence measure, expert-knowledge benchmark, leaderboard, or contamination-free benchmark.
promotion_blockers: Collect current and older cross-family local distributions with independent replication.
Demonstrate category-level and whole-suite headroom below the configured saturation ceiling on current large local models.
Propose a new score version rather than modifying reasoning_exact_answer_v1 in place if empirical evidence supports promotion.

benchmark_status_matrix.sample_policy: Six fresh, independent synthetic cases with new identities and a locked task-id digest; fixture and parser foundation only, with no adapter or runtime execution claim.
benchmark_status_matrix.claim_boundary: Foundation identity only; no benchmark, capability, score, readiness, recommendation, or release-evidence claim.
promotion_blockers: Complete independent review of the fixture, parser, generation policy, and runtime adapter contract.
Run representative cross-family canary evidence and inspect malformed-output behavior before any runnable claim.
Add an adapter only in a separately reviewed change that binds the immutable policy and parser to observed receipts.

benchmark_status_matrix.display_name: Reasoning constraint stress v2 content pack
benchmark_status_matrix.description: Planned identity-only content pack: 40 SHA-derived cases across five reasoning families and four structural levels; no adapter, runtime, score, or evidence claim.
benchmark_status_matrix.selection_guidance: Future benchmark content is available for identity and coverage inspection only. It is not runnable and must not inform current capability, score, readiness, recommendation, or release claims.
benchmark_status_matrix.sample_policy: Forty generated cases arranged as five families x four structural levels x two variants; canary, standard, and gold are exact prefixes of 5, 20, and 40 cases with locked digests and family/level coverage. Content identity only; no execution is implemented.
benchmark_status_matrix.claim_boundary: Planned identity-only content pack: 40 SHA-derived cases across five reasoning families and four structural levels; no adapter, runtime, score, or evidence claim.
promotion_blockers: Complete independent review of generated prompts, family oracles, and tier coverage.
Add a separately reviewed adapter only after the strict terminal policy is bound to receipts.
Run representative reasoning-capable canaries and inspect malformed-output and runtime-failure distributions before any evidence role.

benchmark_status_matrix.sample_policy: Pinned MMLU-Pro snapshot with canary, sampled local reference, and deeper/full reference limits.
benchmark_status_matrix.claim_boundary: Sampled MMLU-Pro reference evidence; useful as a broad knowledge/reasoning reference signal, not a leaderboard or gold claim.
promotion_blockers: Observed duration and token-volume metadata are needed for stronger local recommendation copy.
Observed local runs are needed to calibrate duration and failure behavior.
Leaderboard-style claims require the full official protocol and separate publication controls.

benchmark_status_matrix.sample_policy: Official 198-question GPQA Diamond split with domain-round-robin canary and standard samples.
benchmark_status_matrix.claim_boundary: Sampled GPQA Diamond expert multiple-choice evidence only; diagnostic, not part of Capability protocol v3.1, a leaderboard, or a global intelligence claim.
promotion_blockers: Run a cross-family distribution audit before assigning headline score weight.
Observe duration, malformed-output, and repeatability behavior on supported local runtimes.
Keep the official dataset revision, archive hash, license, and strict answer protocol pinned.

benchmark_status_matrix.sample_policy: Six deterministic exact-key retrieval tasks across nominal 4K, 8K, and 16K context buckets; standard runs one task per bucket.
benchmark_status_matrix.claim_boundary: Exact retrieval at the recorded prompt lengths only; not broad long-context reasoning, advertised maximum context, or production reliability.
promotion_blockers: Audit cross-model and cross-runtime score distributions and actual prompt-token counts.
Measure repeatability and failure behavior at every context bucket.
Do not fold retrieval accuracy into Capability protocol v3.1.

benchmark_status_matrix.sample_policy: Pinned EvalPlus HumanEval+ revision with deterministic task-id hash-ranked canary and full local reference limits, avoiding upstream positional-prefix bias.
benchmark_status_matrix.claim_boundary: EvalPlus HumanEval+ reference coding evidence under pass@1 unit tests; not repo-edit, LiveCodeBench, SWE-bench, gold, or broad agentic coding proof.
promotion_blockers: Observed duration and token-volume metadata are needed for stronger local recommendation copy.
Observed local runs are needed to calibrate duration and failure behavior.
Gold or leaderboard-style claims require separate publication controls and maintainer review.

benchmark_status_matrix.sample_policy: Pinned EvalPlus MBPP+ revision with deterministic task-id hash-ranked canary and sampled local reference limits plus the full local reference tier, avoiding upstream positional-prefix bias.
benchmark_status_matrix.claim_boundary: EvalPlus MBPP+ reference coding breadth evidence under pass@1 unit tests; not repo-edit, LiveCodeBench, SWE-bench, gold, or broad agentic coding proof.
promotion_blockers: Observed duration and token-volume metadata are needed for stronger local recommendation copy.
Observed local runs are needed to calibrate duration and failure behavior.
Gold or leaderboard-style claims require separate publication controls and maintainer review.

benchmark_status_matrix.sample_policy: Pinned InferGrade quant-fidelity corpus under infergrade_perplexity_v1; directly comparable only when model family, checkpoint, tokenizer, corpus, and protocol match.
benchmark_status_matrix.claim_boundary: Same-family quant-fidelity reference evidence only; perplexity does not prove assistant, coding, reasoning, cross-family quality, or general model capability.

Reference precision baselines are needed before Hub can present quality-retention deltas.
Gold or leaderboard-style quant claims require deeper corpus controls and maintainer review.

benchmark_status_matrix.sample_policy: Short local deployment profile for TTFT, load time, and output speed.
benchmark_status_matrix.claim_boundary: Deployment fitness evidence only; speed does not prove answer quality.
promotion_blockers: Observed hardware/runtime duration bands are needed before stronger local comparison claims.

benchmark_status_matrix.sample_policy: Throughput-oriented local deployment profile for offline generation.
benchmark_status_matrix.claim_boundary: Deployment throughput evidence only; not task capability or quant fidelity.
promotion_blockers: Observed duration, variance, and hardware normalization metadata are needed for stronger comparison copy.

benchmark_status_matrix.sample_policy: Longer-context local deployment profile for latency and memory behavior.
benchmark_status_matrix.claim_boundary: Long-context deployment fitness evidence only; not long-context reasoning quality.
promotion_blockers: Observed memory and variance metadata are needed before stronger local comparison copy.

benchmark_status_matrix.sample_policy: Future local preference-style reference candidate only after judge policy and prompt set are reviewed.
benchmark_status_matrix.claim_boundary: Future preference-style assistant reference candidate; not a default local lane or leaderboard-style result.
promotion_blockers: Define deterministic or reviewed judge policy.
Pin prompt fixtures and isolate subjective scoring limitations.

benchmark_status_matrix.sample_policy: Eight pinned miniature Python repository repairs spanning state, parsing, policy, security, data transformation, and scheduling; canary runs two and standard runs six.
benchmark_status_matrix.claim_boundary: Diagnostic local repository-edit evidence only; zero headline weight and not SWE-bench, LiveCodeBench, autonomous-agent, arbitrary-repository, or leaderboard evidence.
promotion_blockers: Run a cross-family distribution audit before assigning headline score weight.
Measure malformed-patch, timeout, duration, repeatability, and ceiling rates across current and historical model bands.
Replace or expand fixtures if the component ceiling rate breaches the headroom gate.

benchmark_status_matrix.sample_policy: Future release-pinned, objective-scored reasoning subset only after a harder local mix clears the headroom policy.
benchmark_status_matrix.claim_boundary: Research candidate for refreshable reasoning evidence; not runnable, not a leaderboard reproduction, and not proof of future headroom.
promotion_blockers: Define a bounded objective-scored local subset and pin every release input.
Demonstrate at least ten points of headroom across current challenge models.
Collect cross-family, independent-repeat, category-slice, and local-duration evidence.

benchmark_status_matrix.sample_policy: Forty-eight LiveCodeBench v6 tasks balanced across AtCoder and LeetCode, easy/medium/hard labels, and January-April 2025 month blocks; canary runs six and standard runs eighteen.

benchmark_status_matrix.sandbox_requirement: offline read-only root supervisor with only SETUID, SETGID, and KILL for irreversible nobody subprocess execution and timeout cleanup; generated children clear those capabilities, hidden inputs are passed one at a time, and expected outputs remain in the root scorer
benchmark_status_matrix.claim_boundary: Pinned LiveCodeBench v6-derived local Python pass@1 candidate only; not an official leaderboard, pass@10, SWE-bench, repository-edit, general software-engineering, or post-April-2025 contamination-free claim.
promotion_blockers: Resolve and record the inconsistent upstream dataset-license metadata before publishing a protocol image.
Publish and independently verify the exact protocol image before making the check selectable.
Collect cross-family duration, failure, repeatability, discrimination, and ceiling-rate evidence before any stronger product role.

benchmark_status_matrix.sample_policy: Future tiny pinned SWE-bench Verified subset with maintainer review and sandboxed environment metadata.
benchmark_status_matrix.claim_boundary: Future gold evidence candidate only; not runnable, not default laptop evidence, and not a public leaderboard claim.
promotion_blockers: Define legal/access and task-subset policy.
Implement sandboxed environment prep and maintainer-review workflow.
Block product copy from presenting this as self-run local default evidence.

benchmark_status_matrix.sample_policy: Hash-ranked 110-case BFCL V4 subset balanced across 11 static and live single-turn selection, parallel, and relevance categories; canary and standard tiers round-robin across every category.
benchmark_status_matrix.claim_boundary: Pinned BFCL-derived local structured tool-use diagnostic only; not an official BFCL score, native runtime function-calling proof, multi-turn tool-use result, or agent-autonomy claim.
promotion_blockers: Collect independently replicated local distributions before treating the tool-use facet as empirically broad.
Demonstrate headroom below the configured saturation ceiling on current large local models.
Implement a separately identified stateful multi-turn or agentic lane before making those broader claims.

benchmark_status_matrix.claim_boundary: Synthetic stateful local tool-loop diagnostic only; zero headline weight and not native function calling, external side-effect, long-horizon autonomy, BFCL, GAIA, or leaderboard evidence.
promotion_blockers: Collect cross-family local distributions and independently replicated observations.
Demonstrate headroom below the configured saturation ceiling on current large local models.
Replace or expand trajectories if ceiling rates breach the headroom gate.

The gold tier has one structured-data easy case because the only second upstream row exceeds the reviewed 131072-token estimate ceiling.
benchmark_status_matrix.expected_duration_token_volume_status: estimated large; 6 to 23 contexts in reviewed 16K to 131K nominal context buckets
benchmark_status_matrix.sandbox_requirement: offline_read_only_container_for_prepare and scoring; generation allocates reviewed nominal context buckets and preserves per-case failures when the runtime or model cannot fit them
benchmark_status_matrix.claim_boundary: Pinned LongBench v2-derived short-context local reference only; not an official leaderboard, medium/long context, maximum-context, or general long-context capability claim.
promotion_blockers: Collect cross-family distributions and independently replicated observations.
Observe duration, actual prompt-token counts, memory-fit failures, resumability, and malformed-output behavior on supported local runtimes.
Demonstrate headroom on current large local models before any stronger product claim.

score_policies.description: Use IFEval prompt-level strict accuracy as the primary assistant instruction-following score.
Score short assistant transcripts by deterministic retention of corrected facts, output constraints, and user preferences.
Score a case only when its complete structured answer matches the pinned expected JSON value; malformed or extra prose does not pass.
Use exact answer-letter accuracy for sampled multiple-choice reference checks.

score_policies.display_name: Strict answer-letter accuracy with empty-think normalization
score_policies.description: Use strict answer-letter accuracy after removing only a leading empty thinking wrapper and trailing runtime terminal markers. Completed malformed answers score incorrect; generation failures remain unscored execution failures.

Score the pinned LongBench v2-derived short-context subset by deterministic A/B/C/D answer-letter accuracy. Completed malformed answers score incorrect; generation failures remain unscored execution failures.

Score strict JSON tool-call arrays against pinned BFCL V4 function selection, argument alternatives, parallel calls, and relevance abstention. This local prompt/scorer contract is not an official BFCL protocol score.
Score complete strict-JSON trajectories across separate model generations, executed deterministic simulator results, opaque-token chaining, guarded abstention, and exact finish states.
Score compact local reasoning prompts with deterministic exact-answer matching.

score_policies.display_name: Reasoning constraint exact answer with diagnostic slices
score_policies.description: Score completed cases by deterministic exact-answer matching and report category and structural-tier accuracy slices; generation failures remain unscored partial evidence.

score_policies.display_name: Reasoning constraint stress v2 terminal integer
score_policies.description: Foundation scoring identity for the six-case v2 fixture; no adapter or runtime execution is claimed.
Score only exact retrieval of the pinned key at the recorded nominal context bucket and observed prompt length.

score_policies.display_name: Coding primary pass@1 with normalized completions
score_policies.description: Use EvalPlus pass@1+ after versioned code-only prompting, unambiguous fence extraction, HumanEval body conversion, and fail-closed scorer validation. HumanEval+ is the core decision signal; MBPP+ adds breadth.
Score small local coding outputs with deterministic static constraints and explicit malformed-output failure states.
Apply a bounded unified diff to a pinned miniature repository and score task success with hidden deterministic tests inside the recorded isolated scorer container.
Expose latency and throughput metrics as deployment evidence without folding them into task capability score.
Use lower perplexity as a supplemental quant-fidelity signal for nearby quantized variants.

benchmark_scopes.description: Short, local-friendly checks intended to help choose a quantized setup for a concrete use case.
Deeper, heavier checks intended for stronger comparison evidence after the first decision path works.

evidence_lanes.description: Minimal execution evidence that proves a setup can run one small path without supporting quality conclusions.
evidence_lanes.claim_boundary: Useful for confirming the setup runs. Not enough for model quality, recommendation, or leaderboard-style claims.

evidence_lanes.description: Short, local-friendly evidence that can help choose which quantized setup to try on this hardware and use case.
evidence_lanes.claim_boundary: Good for choosing a practical next setup. Not enough by itself for leaderboard-style model quality claims.

evidence_lanes.description: Broader or heavier evidence that strengthens comparisons after the first local decision path works.
evidence_lanes.claim_boundary: Useful for comparing nearby variants and families when decision evidence is too thin.

evidence_lanes.description: High-legitimacy evidence that needs curated datasets, stronger reproducibility controls, or heavier execution.
evidence_lanes.claim_boundary: Best for trusted public claims, but usually too expensive or operationally sensitive for a default laptop run.

capability_surfaces.description: Instruction-following, structured-output, conversational retention, and assistant behavior evidence from pinned local tasks.
capability_surfaces.claim_boundary: Useful for a local assistant setup choice when paired with clear task counts and caveats. Not a global assistant ranking.

capability_surfaces.description: Coding generation, repair, structured patch, and bounded repo-edit evidence from deterministic local tasks.
capability_surfaces.claim_boundary: Useful for coding-oriented setup choices. Not a SWE-bench or agentic software engineering claim unless gold gates are met.

capability_surfaces.description: Exact-answer, multiple-choice, or structured reasoning checks that can run locally under pinned fixture rules.
capability_surfaces.claim_boundary: Useful as a narrow reasoning signal. Not an expert reasoning or restricted-dataset claim without reference or gold controls.

capability_surfaces.description: Deterministic retrieval evidence at recorded prompt lengths and runtime context settings.
capability_surfaces.claim_boundary: Useful for checking whether a local setup retrieves a pinned key at a measured prompt length. Not broad long-context reasoning or maximum-context proof.

capability_surfaces.description: Perplexity or reference-output evidence for nearby quantized artifacts.
capability_surfaces.claim_boundary: Useful for quant-to-quant comparison. Not a general capability score.

capability_surfaces.description: Runtime, latency, throughput, memory, and stability evidence for a local setup.
capability_surfaces.claim_boundary: Useful for whether a setup fits the hardware and interaction pattern. Not proof that the model answers well.

suites.description: Assistant-style prompting, instruction adherence, and the latency signals people use to judge everyday chat quality.
Coding completions, practical editing behavior, and the longer interactive prompts that matter for local coding assistants.
Exact-answer reasoning plus a sampled broad-knowledge reference signal for local setup decisions.
Reference-text perplexity that helps compare nearby quantized variants when task scores cluster tightly.

benchmark_groups.description: Run IFEval to check whether the model follows detailed textual instructions cleanly.
Run short multi-turn transcript checks for remembered facts, corrections, and output constraints.
Run stricter synthetic tasks that combine corrections, filtering, ordering, and exact structured output.
Run complementary single-turn BFCL-derived structured calls and synthetic stateful local tool-loop trajectories.
Run a sampled MMLU-Pro reference pass for harder broad knowledge and reasoning coverage.
Run GPQA Diamond as a diagnostic expert multiple-choice reference.
Measure deterministic key retrieval at nominal 4K, 8K, and 16K prompt buckets.
Run a pinned LongBench v2-derived short-context subset across six realistic task domains.
Run small native exact-answer reasoning prompts scored by deterministic answer matching.
Legacy direct-no-think diagnostic retained for forensic artifacts; not a runnable benchmark until a reasoning-capable successor protocol is qualified.
Run small native coding repair prompts scored by deterministic static output constraints.
Apply model-generated patches to pinned miniature repositories and run hidden deterministic tests in an isolated scorer.
Run HumanEval+ for the most important pass@1 coding signal.
Add MBPP+ for broader everyday coding coverage beyond the core set.
Measure TTFT, load time, and output speed for interactive requests.
Measure throughput-oriented generation behavior under a small batch load.
Measure latency and memory pressure under longer prompts.
Run the shared perplexity reference pass for quant-to-quant comparisons.

checks.description: Instruction-following benchmark.
Short transcript-retention benchmark for corrected facts, remembered preferences, and output constraints.
checks.selection_guidance: Adds a quick local smoke signal for whether an assistant retains facts and corrections. The check is diagnostic-only because the public corpus reached its ceiling across widely different model sizes.

checks.description: Pinned synthetic assistant tasks that combine state corrections, filtering, ordering, conditional rules, and strict JSON output.
checks.selection_guidance: Adds a higher-resolution local instruction-following signal after the five-case memory microcheck saturated.

checks.description: Pinned BFCL-derived single-turn diagnostic for structured function selection, arguments, parallel calls, and relevance abstention using a strict local JSON call contract.
checks.selection_guidance: Adds a broad structured tool-use diagnostic while keeping its local JSON prompt format and single-turn scope distinct from official BFCL, native tool calling, multi-turn, and agentic claims.

checks.description: Pinned synthetic multi-generation diagnostic that executes deterministic local tool results between strict JSON calls and scores complete trajectories.
checks.selection_guidance: Adds a distinct stateful diagnostic after single-turn BFCL-derived calls: each case uses separate generations, deterministic executed results, opaque-token chaining, conditional abstention, and exact final state.

checks.description: Sampled harder broad knowledge and reasoning benchmark.
checks.selection_guidance: Adds a sampled reference signal for broad knowledge and reasoning. It is stronger than a quick decision check but not a leaderboard claim.

checks.description: Official expert-level multiple-choice reference split with strict answer-letter scoring.
checks.selection_guidance: Adds a harder diagnostic expert-reasoning reference without changing the Capability protocol v3.1 score.

checks.description: Pinned short-context LongBench v2-derived multiple-choice reference across six realistic task domains and both difficulty labels.
checks.selection_guidance: Adds deterministic task-reasoning evidence beyond key retrieval while limiting the first local lane to the upstream short length stratum.

checks.description: Deterministic exact-key retrieval at nominal 4K, 8K, and 16K prompt buckets.
checks.selection_guidance: Measures retrieval at three local context buckets without claiming broad long-context reasoning or maximum-context support.

checks.description: Small local reasoning prompts scored by deterministic exact-answer matching.
checks.selection_guidance: Adds a quick native reasoning signal for exact-answer tasks. It is a thin local sample and not a broad reasoning benchmark.

checks.description: Broader pinned synthetic exact-answer tasks across state tracking, graph planning, modular recurrences, set reasoning, dependency planning, and arrangement counting.

checks.description: Planned identity-only content pack: 40 SHA-derived cases across five reasoning families and four structural levels; no adapter, runtime, score, or evidence claim.

planned_benchmark_candidates.value: Adds preference-style assistant quality evidence for models that look similar on instruction following.
planned_benchmark_candidates.cost: medium token volume; requires careful prompt and judge policy design
planned_benchmark_candidates.why_not_default: Needs an explicit judge policy before it can be trusted as a local decision score.

planned_benchmark_candidates.value: Adds objective, release-pinned reasoning tasks from a benchmark designed to refresh its question sources over time.
planned_benchmark_candidates.cost: unknown local duration; requires a bounded objective-scored subset and release-by-release fixture review
planned_benchmark_candidates.why_not_default: Refreshability does not guarantee headroom. The observed 2026-06-25 reasoning leaderboard leaves only 8.3 points at the top, below InferGrade's 10-point minimum; a harder bounded local mix must independently pass cross-family, challenger, and slice audits before becoming runnable.

planned_benchmark_candidates.value: Adds temporally newer execution-tested coding tasks beyond static HumanEval+/MBPP+ style checks.
planned_benchmark_candidates.cost: 6 to 48 generations plus 208 to 1895 sandboxed tests; observed local duration is still pending
planned_benchmark_candidates.why_not_default: The pinned scorer is implemented, but upstream license metadata must be resolved and the protocol image verified before the lane can become selectable.

planned_benchmark_candidates.value: Adds high-legitimacy software-engineering task evidence for the strongest coding setups.
planned_benchmark_candidates.cost: very large token volume and long wall-clock runtime; likely cloud or maintainer-reviewed gold lane first
planned_benchmark_candidates.why_not_default: Operationally expensive enough that it should start as maintainer-reviewed gold evidence, not a default laptop run.
